messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: latency SLO breach detected for model redwood-3b-int8 (hosted-us-east). p95 > 800ms, p99 > 2.5s over last 5m. Automated calib rollout changed int8 profile 03:45 UTC. Paging oncall.
Maya Rao: seeing big spike in streaming stalls, clients report cut/partial streams. Loading graphs now.
Leo Chen: confirmed. Tail hist shows a bimodal distribution after 03:45, long tail correlated with large context requests.
Samir Patel: any rollout logs? which hosts got the new profile?
Iris K.: rollout id rollout-2026-07-12-0342. Applied to pool gpu-pool-a[12-19]. Canary passed at 03:40 with tiny sample.
Maya Rao: can we rollback that profile to prev-int8-02?
Jordan (oncall): initiating rollback now. Applying prev-int8-02 to gpu-pool-a. ETA ~60s.
incident-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED by Jordan (oncall) at 03:47.
Samir Patel: while rollback runs, enable routing fallback to redwood-3b-fp16 for streaming-heavy routes (route tags: /stream/*). That will reduce throughput but avoid stalls.
Iris K.: traffic-split change: 80% -> int8 pool, 20% -> fp16. I'll flip to 50/50 now.
Maya Rao: quick customer impact estimate: about 1400 active streams, errors ~2.3% and increased client-side disconnects. SLA p95 target 300ms, p99 target 1.5s — currently p95=820ms, p99=2.6s.
Emily - CS: flagged top 3 enterprise tenants on watch. Sending brief to AMs.
Leo Chen: logs show spikes of GEMM dequantization times on some nodes:
```
2026-07-12T03:46:12Z host=gpu-12 kernel=dequantize_int8_to_fp32 time_ms=112.4
2026-07-12T03:46:13Z host=gpu-15 kernel=dequantize_int8_to_fp32 time_ms=98.7
2026-07-12T03:46:14Z host=gpu-12 kvcache_miss=1
```
Maya Rao: suspicion: calibration changed activation scaling leading to heavier dequant paths and cache churn.
Samir Patel: is this KV cache eviction related? any OOMs?
Iris K.: no OOMs, but kv cache hit ratio dropped from 98% -> 72% for affected hosts.
Jordan (oncall): rollback complete on gpu-pool-a at 03:49. Metrics beginning to stabilize on some hosts.
incident-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE at 03:49. Noted decrease in error rate but tail still elevated.
Maya Rao: partial improvement - p95 down to 420ms but p99 still ~1.9s. Some hosts still showing slow dequant.
Leo Chen: pushing a targeted restart of the runtime on hosts gpu-12 and gpu-15 to clear stale calibration caches. Will coordinate.
Samir Patel: +1. Plan: restart runtime on those two hosts one at a time, verify kv hit ratio, then re-run profile scrub tool.
Iris K.: runtime restart on gpu-12 requested. Doing rolling restart now.
Maya Rao: customer impact update: error rate down to 0.8%, streaming incomplete rate 0.6%. Notified oncall page for escalation if p99 > 2s after 15m.
incident-bot: RUNTIME RESTART START on gpu-12 at 03:55 by Iris K.
Leo Chen: kv hit ratio on gpu-12 back to 96% after restart. Dequant latency median improved.
Iris K.: restarting gpu-15 now.
incident-bot: RUNTIME RESTART START on gpu-15 at 03:58.
Jordan (oncall): after both restarts, rerouting will be gradually rolled back to original traffic split over 10m if metrics stable.
Maya Rao: p95=330ms, p99=1.3s now. Still above SLO target for p99 slightly.
Samir Patel: we should run a targeted calibration-validation job (calib-verify) against a representative prompt set to ensure int8 profile is safe before re-rolling.
Iris K.: running calib-verify now. Output will include per-layer scale deltas and synthetic latency run.
incident-bot: calib-verify job started (job-id=calib-verify-213654).
Leo Chen: results show several layers with unusual activation scale shifts > 12% compared to baseline, matching dequant slope. Recommendation: mark profile-03 for quarantine.
Maya Rao: agree. Block any automated rollouts for int8 profile-03 and open a postmortem ticket.
Jordan (oncall): documented actions: rollback applied, two host restarts, temporary routing to fp16 for 10m, calib-verify run, profile quarantined. Handing off to day oncall Samir for follow-up.
Samir Patel: taking handoff. Will coordinate with infra to scrub affected images and run broader canary with synthetic long-context streams.
Emily - CS: CS update sent to customers and AMs. Offering status page link and ETA for postmortem.
Maya Rao: postmortem owner assigned: Samir. Include timeline, graphs per-host, calib diff, and mitigation notes.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: Oncall handoff from Jordan -> Samir at 04:12.
Samir Patel: will schedule a deeper investigation with model ops and runtime teams. Opening a follow-up thread for remediation work.
Maya Rao: nice work team. We avoided a full paging escalation and most customers saw mild impact. Please attach any logs/commands to the follow-up. :thumbsup:
